title: Nice Pot, Wonky Lid
text: Nice Pot, Wonky Lid. Attractive cookware. Well made pot. I had to deduct a star because the lid I got is warped and does not fit the pot correctly or tightly. It rocks back and forth. Love the handles as they are easy to grip for older hands and they don't heat up. Perfect size for a batch of marinara, or a moderate soup or stock amount. This can go in the dishwasher which is fab, because the inside will clean and the outside is coated to prevent etching. If my lid fit, I would be giving 4 or more stars

product_metadata.title: Rachael Ray Brights Hard Anodized Nonstick Stock Pot/Stockpot with Lid, 8 Quart, Marine Blue
features: CRAFTED FOR CONVENIENCE: Dishwashable hard-anodized aluminum cookware set promotes fast, even heating, interiors coated in long-lasting nonstick for beautiful food release
COMFORT AND CONTROL: Colorful handles on the pots and pans are double riveted for strength and rubberized for grip and comfort
PUT A LID ON IT: Shatter-resistant glass lids on the covered pots and pans make it easy to monitor the cooking
VERSATILE BY DESIGN: Nonstick cookware set is oven safe to 350 degrees F and conveniently dishwasher safe for quick and easy clean up
description: If the pot is versatile enough to simmer soup, boil water and braise a stew - and is fun and stylish to boot – the cookware piece must be the Rachael Ray Hard-Anodized Nonstick 8-Quart Covered Stockpot. Count on Rachael Ray for top-quality cookware that cooks like a champ and cleans in a jiff. Designed to tackle so many common cooking tasks, this roomy stockpot features long-lasting, hard-anodized construction that heats swiftly and evenly, and the interior is coated in durable nonstick for impeccable food release and easy cleanup. Use the colorful stockpot to create a satisfying batch of Rachael's Chicken and Herb Pot Pie Stoup or Drunken Spaghetti with Hot Salami Meat Sauce. A shatter-resistant glass lid makes it easy to monitor foods while they cook without losing heat or moisture. This stockpot is oven safe to 350°F and dishwasher safe for convenience, and works great as a chili pot, pasta pot, lobster pot, and more. Plus it complements many other pieces in Rachael’s collections. Experience the fun fusion of practical cooking performance and contemporary kitchen style with the Rachael Ray 8-Quart Hard-Anodized Nonstick Stockpot with Lid.
